'''Zheres''' was a man who [[Birgitte Silverbow]] encountered or knew of in one of her lifetimes.
== History ==
[[Mathena]] looked down upon men until she was kissed by Zheres. She fell madly in love with him, and he had to live on a mountain to escape her pursuit.{{ref/book|5|47}}
== Parallels ==
Zheres's name appears to be a combination of [[wikipedia:Zeus|Zeus]] and [[wikipedia:Ares|Ares]], two prominent Greek gods, which is similar to his love Mathena, which is similar to Athena. This echoes the similarities of Birgitte to Greek mythology overall.
